title: Bob Robin's River City Records and the Baton Rouge session
summary: Ridgley recalls River City sides recorded in Baton Rouge with Bob Robin, a guitarist's playing, and unreleased tracks and a good-selling record.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography
